defects.problem: After pending prepareClose, obsolete false/rejection was returned as blocked or wrote an error onto a replacement buffer before checking ownership.
defects.fix: Capture tab/content instance and check it after each resolution and in catch, before blocked/error. Obsolete allowed/blocked/rejected all return stale; replacement tab/draft/error remains intact.

defects.problem: Shared prototype close prompt survived a task-prop scope switch; captured old key could address a new task draft.
defects.fix: Key LocalFileWorkspace by task/host/cwd and guard discard using captured scope/tab/draft object identities. New/reopened draft is not discarded by an old context.

cleanup.boundary: Own fixture cleanup only. Receiver tasks killed through original tasks.kill, harness closes only its child. This is not a normal-quit assertion.

boundaries: A r43 actual packaged App, own project/userData and two public task/profile-created PTYs running input-only Python fixture. No model or shell commands. Actual file controls, task selection, editor input and close. Native process/Pty IDs and continuous heartbeat observed, raw input0 and executed commands0.

D10 last file closes to approved empty panel, plus-control focus; actual task stays running with same PTY/receiver and advancing output. I checks released document ref is UNTRUSTED while same scope root/list and empty SQLite checkpoint remain. P empty/focus is file-region only, synthetic task prop does not prove a PTY.

D18 original authenticated open results for T1 A/B held only after actual IO, switch to real T2 C, reverse delivery, wait original drafts and two frames. T2 exact state/checkpoint/active tab/editor focus stay; T1 returns A/B activeB. I uses same FileService/real native/real SQLite/shared event owner and explicit view disconnect/reconnect; synthetic task source resolver is not real task-service/PTY evidence.

D11 I original native save already wrote OLD; only original receipt delayed. Real FileBuffer replacement assigned via explicit I lifecycle fault seam, real new checkpoint/readDraft, then old success returns stale and cannot close tab/error/draft. U separately covers old true/false/rejected. No direct store mutation in A.

D11 A actual own renderer forcefullyCrashRenderer (reason killed/exit2) then same WebContents reload while old original successful native save reply held in surviving main. Reopened A gets fresh native ref/lease and independently typed NEW draft. Late old receipt belongs to disconnected frame, not current; current tab/text/new durable draft retained. This is complementary disconnection A, not a claim of same-Store replacement from UI. Production beforeunload/close guard unchanged.

Initial r43 driver attempted beforeunload accept after Electron had already vetoed/closed it: unhandled No dialog is showing exited driver before result/finally. Separate process audit proves own App/receivers already exited, no handler-restoration proof for that failed attempt. Fixed immediate Promise rejection handling; second attempt records dialogClosed result=false and unchanged navigation, correctly failed rather than forced/reported pass. Final uses explicitly scoped own renderer crash fault.

P shared file-region, parent task props and background completion explicitly synthetic. Light/dark6 scenes. Old T1 close prompt removed on scope switch; model4 tests additionally cover same-route close/reopen, newer draft and other-scope completion. Added all-scope demo restore completion is not real IO. No complete Codex pixel claim.

Related code76pass0skip (6new U/I), P50model4new/6scenes, actual App3new/6affected tab regressions. Typecheck, prototype build and six fresh native smokes/81 runtime hashes match. Historical code union1773 is not a fresh full run; old2CLIopt-ins not selected.

980 sources build/final differ only external task-file-lifecycle-ui driver. Four immutable source archives retain red production guard, red prototype task modal, build and final. A.txt old/new fixture writes expected, B/C hash/inode/mtime unchanged. Final cleanup may legitimately flush NEW A via original task kill; no normal-quit claim from harness.close.

All6 original handler identities restored and held3 replies delivered with identical hashes; own App/receivers absent after cleanup. No oldr4/r6pending57bytes, AIS, daily resources, system clipboard, OS dialogs/permissions, external services, commit/push/merge/tag/release. Stage still active.
